_comment: Files that translate a species enum to es-AR themselves instead of importing speciesLabel / speciesLabelPlural from lib/utils/format.ts. This is DEBT, not approval: the same pattern shipped a raw-enum leak on 2026-07-08 and, on 2026-08-08, a ternary that rendered every non-dog species as 'Gatos'. The list may only SHRINK — the fence fails both on a NEW entry and on a stale one, so fixing a file means deleting its line here. Most of what is left are filter option lists whose VALUE set is a deliberate product choice (dog/cat/other) but whose spelling should still come from the shared map; two are deliberate register variants ('Perro/a', 'Cobayo / Cuy') that need a wording decision before they move. Guarded by __tests__/species-label-single-source.test.ts.
